summary: Connect a vector-output dense–ReLU layer and its automatically generated gradients to the actual TorchLean graph.

For the supplied binary32 forward kernel, every admitted completed execution stores outputs within the derived bound of the TorchLean real graph, under explicit encoding and calculated range conditions; inputs and memory extents are preserved and every emitted access is in bounds.

Keep a complete admitted execution witness separate from universal correctness. Zero output rows require no launch. The kernel uses one bounded cooperating thread array, a fixed reduction tree and fresh scratch planes; parallel backward implementation and proofs remain unfinished.
remaining: Implemented: actual TorchLean matrix graph and generated VJP; the supplied shape-specialized forward instruction list; a complete admitted execution witness; and universal stored-output correctness for every admitted completed candidate execution. Computed load and store addresses, producer existence, unique ownership and actual completed barriers force global initialization reads and shared producer reads. Induction over the actual interleaving proves the arithmetic meaning of live registers and emitted stores, retaining all permitted binary32 result choices. Final-memory correspondence, unchanged input words, preserved extents and access safety follow. Encoding and calculated range conditions connect every stored row to the actual TorchLean graph, including zero padding and empty inputs. The empty-output wrapper has no launch or memory change and satisfies the same forward contract. Missing: the separately supplied parallel backward kernel and its stored dx, dW and db proofs. Larger multi-array launches, runtime/ABI correspondence, hardware conformance and benchmarks are outside this first forward kernel.

The layer takes an input vector x of length n, a trainable m-by-n weight matrix W,
and a bias vector b of length m. It returns y_i=max(sum_j W_ij*x_j+b_i,0).
Its automatically generated TorchLean backward takes an incoming sensitivity
vector d of length m. With g_i=d_i on a positive affine value and zero otherwise,
it returns dx_j=sum_i W_ij*g_i, dW_ij=g_i*x_j and db_i=g_i. A zero derivative at
an exactly zero affine value is a chosen convention; ordinary mathematical
differentiation requires every relevant affine value to be nonzero.

structure Encoding (s : Dense.Shape) (global : List Word)
    (x : Tensor ℝ (DenseVJP.column s.columns))
    (w : Tensor ℝ (DenseVJP.matrix s.rows s.columns))
    (b : Tensor ℝ (DenseVJP.column s.rows)) where
  entry : Fin s.rows → Fin s.columns → DotError.Input
  weightWord : ∀ r c, (entry r c).left = global[s.weight r.val c.val]!
  inputWord : ∀ r c, (entry r c).right = global[c.val]!
  weightIdeal : ∀ r c, (entry r c).l = Spec.get2 w r c
  inputIdeal : ∀ r c, (entry r c).r = Spec.get2 x c 0
  biasValue : Fin s.rows → ℝ
  biasError : Fin s.rows → ℝ
  biasReal : ∀ r, finiteReal global[s.biasBase+r.val]! = some (biasValue r)
  biasApprox : ∀ r, |biasValue r-Spec.get2 b r 0| ≤ biasError r
  treeSafe : ∀ r, Reduction.Safe (Reduction.balanced s.depth 0 (Reduction.paddedInput (entry r)))
  additionRange : ∀ r, |Reduction.rounded (Reduction.balanced s.depth 0 (Reduction.paddedInput (entry r)))+

theorem candidate_load_address (s : Shape) (b : Bounds s) (global shared : List Word)
    (seeds : Fin s.threads → Scalar.State) {events : List (Event s.threads)} {final : Parallel.State s.threads}

    (∃ weight : Bool, occ.pc=(if weight then 15 else 11) ∧ space=.global ∧ t.val%s.width<s.columns ∧
      effect.address=bytePointer (if weight then s.weight (t.val/s.width) (t.val%s.width) else t.val%s.width)) ∨
    (∃ k, k<s.depth ∧ ∃ right : Bool, occ.pc=22+16*k+(if right then 8 else 7) ∧ space=.shared ∧
      t.val%s.width<2^(s.depth-(k+1)) ∧ effect.address=bytePointer (leftIndex s k t+if right then 1 else 0)) ∨
    (∃ bias : Bool, occ.pc=22+16*s.depth+(if bias then 10 else 5) ∧ space=(if bias then .global else .shared) ∧
      t.val%s.width=0 ∧ effect.address=bytePointer (if bias then biasIndex s t else rootIndex s t)) :=

For every admitted completed execution, the resulting instruction arithmetic

passage.quote:
theorem universal_forward (s : Dense.Shape) (bounds : Dense.Bounds s) (global shared : List Word)
    (seeds : Fin s.threads → Ptx.Scalar.State)
    (x : Tensor ℝ (DenseVJP.column s.columns))
    (w : Tensor ℝ (DenseVJP.matrix s.rows s.columns))
    (b : Tensor ℝ (DenseVJP.column s.rows)) (encoding : Encoding s global x w b)
    {events : List (Event s.threads)} {final : State s.threads}
    (run : Runs (Dense.config s bounds) (Dense.program s) (Dense.initial s global shared seeds) events final)
    (halted : ∀ t, (final.lanes t).halted=true) (source co)
    (valid : Dense.Admitted s bounds global shared seeds run source co) :
    (∀ row : Fin s.rows, ∃ value, final.global[s.outputBase+row.val]?=some value ∧
      finiteReal value=some (max (encoding.row row).affine 0) ∧
      |max (encoding.row row).affine 0-
        Spec.get2 ((DenseVJP.graph s.rows s.columns).forward (DenseVJP.inputs x w b)) row 0| ≤ (encoding.row row).error) ∧
    (∀ i, i<s.outputBase → final.global[i]?=global[i]?) ∧
    final.global.length=global.length ∧ final.shared.length=shared.length ∧
    (∀ event ∈ events, AccessSafe (Dense.initial s global shared seeds) event) :=
